akhfash:25-25.t:
He said ﴿وَٱلْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفاً﴾ (conjoined) on "and they barred" ﴿الهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفاً﴾ (the sacrificial animals, detained), out of aversion ﴿أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ﴾ (to its reaching its place of sacrifice).
And He said ﴿أَن تَطَئُوهُمْ﴾ as a badal (substitute): "were it not for men — that you trample them".

akhfash:29-29.t: And He said ﴿أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ﴾: He means (the pattern) "أَفْعَلَه" from "الإِزارَة" (supporting).

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ﴾ We decreed the conquest of Mecca and other places in the future, by force, through your jihad ﴿فَتْحًا مُبِينًا﴾ clear, manifest.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ﴾ through your jihad ﴿مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ﴾ of it, so that you may make your community desirous of jihad. It is to be interpreted figuratively, because of the infallibility of the prophets, blessings and peace be upon them, from sins, by decisive rational proof. The lām is for the final cause (al-ʿilla al-ghāʾiyya), so what it governs is an effect, not a cause ﴿وَيُتِمَّ﴾ through the conquest mentioned ﴿نِعْمَتَهُ﴾ His bestowal ﴿عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ﴾ by it ﴿صِرَاطًا﴾ a path ﴿مُسْتَقِيمًا﴾ He makes you firm upon it, and it is the religion of Islam.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَيَنْصُرَكَ اللَّهُ﴾ by it ﴿نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا﴾ possessed of might, with no humiliation in it.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ﴾ tranquillity ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِيمَانًا مَعَ إِيمَانِهِمْ﴾ in the laws of the religion: whenever one of them came down, they believed in it, and among them is jihad ﴿وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ so if He had wished to help His religion through others than you, He would have done so ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا﴾ of His creation ﴿حَكِيمًا﴾ in His making; i.e. He has always been described thus.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿لِيُدْخِلَ﴾ attached (mutaʿalliq) to something omitted, i.e. «أَمَرَ بِالْجِهَادِ» ("He commanded jihad") ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا﴾

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ الظَّانِّينَ بِاللَّهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ﴾ with fatḥa and with ḍamma on the sīn in the three places; they thought that He would not help Muhammad ﷺ and the believers ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ دَائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ﴾ with humiliation and punishment ﴿وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ﴾ He removed them far away ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ وَسَاءَتْ مَصِيرًا﴾ i.e. a place of return.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا﴾ in His dominion ﴿حَكِيمًا﴾ in His making; i.e. He has always been described thus.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا﴾ over your community on the Day of Resurrection ﴿وَمُبَشِّرًا﴾ to them in this world of the Garden ﴿وَنَذِيرًا﴾ a warner, making whoever does evil in it fear the Fire.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ with yāʾ and with tāʾ [لِتُؤْمِنُوا], in it and in the three after it ﴿وَيُعَزِّرُوهُ﴾ and help him; and it was read with two zāys with the tāʾ [وَتُعَزِّزُوهُ] ﴿وَيُوَقِّرُوهُ﴾ honour him; their pronoun refers to Allah or to His Messenger [وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ] ﴿وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ﴾ i.e. Allah [وَيُسَبِّحُوهُ] ﴿بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا﴾ in the morning and the evening. [Translator's note: the source quotes the ayah with yāʾ in the first three verbs and tāʾ in «وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ», with the other reading in brackets; it is translated as printed.]

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ﴾ the Pledge of Riḍwān at al-Ḥudaybiya ﴿إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ اللَّهَ﴾ it is like {مَنْ يُطِعِ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ} ﴿يَدُ اللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ with which they pledged allegiance to the Prophet, i.e. He, Exalted is He, is aware of their pledge and will reward them for it ﴿فَمَنْ نَكَثَ﴾ broke the pledge ﴿فَإِنَّمَا يَنْكُثُ﴾ the evil consequence of his breaking it returns ﴿عَلَى نَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَوْفَى بِمَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهُ اللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ﴾ with yāʾ and with nūn ﴿أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا﴾

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُ لَكَ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ﴾ around Medina, i.e. those whom Allah held back from accompanying you when you asked them to go out with you to Mecca, fearing that Quraysh would confront you, in the year of al-Ḥudaybiya, when you return from it: ﴿شَغَلَتْنَا أَمْوَالُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا﴾ from going out with you ﴿فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا﴾ Allah, for not going out with you. He, Exalted is He, said, belying them: ﴿يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ﴾ i.e. the request for forgiveness and what preceded it ﴿مَا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ so they are lying in their excuse ﴿قُلْ فَمَنْ﴾ an interrogative with the meaning of negation, i.e. no one ﴿يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا﴾ with fatḥa and with ḍamma on the ḍād ﴿أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًا بَلْ كَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا﴾ i.e. He has always been described thus.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ in both places is for moving from one purpose to another ﴿ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَنْقَلِبَ الرَّسُولُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَى أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذَلِكَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ i.e. that they would be wiped out by killing and not return ﴿وَظَنَنْتُمْ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ﴾ this and other things ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا﴾ the plural of «بَائِر», i.e. perishing in the sight of Allah because of this thought.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَمَنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَإِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَعِيرًا﴾ an intense fire.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا﴾ i.e. He has always been described by what has been mentioned.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ﴾ who were mentioned ﴿إِذَا انْطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَى مَغَانِمَ﴾ they are the spoils of Khaybar ﴿لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا﴾ let us ﴿نَتَّبِعْكُمْ﴾ so that we may take some of them ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ by that ﴿أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلَامَ اللَّهِ﴾ and in one reading [كَلِمَ اللَّهِ] with kasra on the lām, i.e. His promises of the spoils of Khaybar to the people of al-Ḥudaybiya specifically ﴿قُلْ لَنْ تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَلِكُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ i.e. before our return ﴿فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا﴾ that we should get some of the spoils with you, so you said that ﴿بَلْ كَانُوا لَا يَفْقَهُونَ﴾ of the religion ﴿إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ among them.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿قُلْ لِلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ﴾ who were mentioned, as a test: ﴿سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى قَوْمٍ أُولِي﴾ possessors of ﴿بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ﴾ it is said they are Banū Ḥanīfa, the people of al-Yamāma, and it is said Persia and Rome ﴿تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ﴾ an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), which in meaning is what they are called to ﴿أَوْ﴾ they ﴿يُسْلِمُونَ﴾ so you do not fight ﴿فَإِنْ تُطِيعُوا﴾ to fight them ﴿يُؤْتِكُمُ اللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا﴾ painful.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَى حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ﴾ in abandoning jihad ﴿وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ﴾ with yāʾ and with nūn ﴿جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ﴾ with yāʾ and with nūn ﴿عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا﴾

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿لَقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ﴾ at al-Ḥudaybiya ﴿تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ﴾ it was an acacia (samura), and they were one thousand three hundred or more; he then took their pledge that they would fight Quraysh and not flee from death ﴿فَعَلِمَ﴾ Allah ﴿مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ of sincerity and loyalty ﴿فَأَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَابَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا﴾ it is the conquest of Khaybar after their departure from al-Ḥudaybiya.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا﴾ from Khaybar ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا﴾ i.e. He has always been described thus.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا﴾ from the conquests ﴿فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَذِهِ﴾ the spoils of Khaybar ﴿وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ النَّاسِ عَنْكُمْ﴾ regarding your families when you went out and the Jews intended [harm] against them, so Allah cast terror into their hearts ﴿وَلِتَكُونَ﴾ i.e. the hastened [spoils]; conjoined to something implied (muqaddar), i.e. «لِتَشْكُرُوهُ» ("so that you may thank Him") ﴿آيَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ in their being helped ﴿وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا﴾ i.e. the path of reliance upon Him and of entrusting the matter to Him, Exalted is He.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَأُخْرَى﴾ an adjective of an implied (muqaddar) «مَغَانِمَ» (spoils); a mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهَا﴾ they are from Persia and Rome ﴿قَدْ أَحَاطَ اللَّهُ بِهَا﴾ He knew that they would be yours ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا﴾ i.e. He has always been described thus.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَلَوْ قَاتَلَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ at al-Ḥudaybiya ﴿لَوَلَّوُا الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا﴾ to guard them ﴿وَلَا نَصِيرًا﴾

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ﴾ a maṣdar (verbal noun) emphasising the content of the clause before it, namely the defeat of the disbelievers and the help of the believers, i.e. «سَنَّ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ سُنَّةً» ("Allah has established that as a way") ﴿الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا﴾ from Him.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ﴾ at al-Ḥudaybiya ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ for eighty of them went around your camp to strike at you, and they were seized and brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he pardoned them and let them go, and that was the cause of the truce ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا﴾ with yāʾ and with tāʾ [تَعْمَلُونَ]; i.e. He has always been described thus.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ﴾ i.e. from reaching it ﴿وَالْهَدْيَ﴾ conjoined to «كُمْ» ﴿مَعْكُوفًا﴾ held back; a ḥāl (circumstantial) ﴿أَنْ يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ﴾ i.e. its place where it is customarily slaughtered, which is the Ḥaram; a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) ﴿وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَاءٌ مُؤْمِنَاتٌ﴾ present in Mecca with the disbelievers ﴿لَمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ﴾ to be characterised by faith ﴿أَنْ تَطَئُوهُمْ﴾ i.e. that you would kill them along with the disbelievers had you been permitted the conquest; a badal ishtimāl of «هُمْ» ﴿فَتُصِيبَكُمْ مِنْهُمْ مَعَرَّةٌ﴾ i.e. a sin ﴿بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ﴾ on your part of it. The third-person pronouns are for both kinds, with the masculine given precedence (taghlīb); and the apodosis (jawāb) of «لَوْلَا» is omitted, i.e. «لَأَذِنَ لَكُمْ فِي الْفَتْحِ» ("He would have permitted you the conquest"), but it was not permitted at that time ﴿لِيُدْخِلَ اللَّهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ such as the believers mentioned ﴿لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا﴾ had they been separated from the disbelievers ﴿لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ﴾ of the people of Mecca at that time, by permitting you its conquest ﴿عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا﴾ painful.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿إِذْ جَعَلَ﴾ attached (mutaʿalliq) to «عَذَّبْنَا» ﴿الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ the fāʿil (agent) ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْحَمِيَّةَ﴾ disdain for something ﴿حَمِيَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ﴾ a badal (substitute) of «الْحَمِيَّةَ»; it was their barring the Prophet and his Companions from the Sacred Mosque ﴿فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ so they made a truce with them on condition that they return the following year, and they were not overtaken by the zealotry that overtook the disbelievers, such that they would fight them ﴿وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ﴾ the believers ﴿كَلِمَةَ التَّقْوَى﴾ «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ» ("There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah"); it is attached in a genitive construct to «التَّقْوَى» because it is its cause ﴿وَكَانُوا أَحَقَّ بِهَا﴾ more entitled to the word than the disbelievers ﴿وَأَهْلَهَا﴾ an explicative conjunction (ʿaṭf tafsīr) ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا﴾ i.e. He has always been described thus, and among what He, Exalted is He, knows is that they are its people.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿لَقَدْ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ الرُّؤْيَا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw in sleep, in the year of al-Ḥudaybiya before setting out, that he and his Companions would enter Mecca in safety, shaving and shortening [their hair]. He told his Companions of that and they rejoiced. When they went out with him and the disbelievers barred them at al-Ḥudaybiya, and they returned, that weighed heavily on them, and some of the hypocrites doubted; so it was revealed. His saying «بِالْحَقِّ» is attached (mutaʿalliq) to «صَدَقَ» or is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الرُّؤْيَا», and what follows it is its explanation: ﴿لَتَدْخُلُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ for blessing ﴿آمِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ﴾ i.e. all their hair ﴿وَمُقَصِّرِينَ﴾ some of their hair; and these are two anticipated ḥāls (ḥālān muqaddaratān) ﴿لَا تَخَافُونَ﴾ ever ﴿فَعَلِمَ﴾ in the truce ﴿مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا﴾ of benefit ﴿فَجَعَلَ مِنْ دُونِ ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. the entry ﴿فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا﴾ it is the conquest of Khaybar; and the vision was fulfilled the following year.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ﴾ i.e. the religion of truth ﴿عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ﴾ over all the remaining religions ﴿وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا﴾ that you are sent with what has been mentioned.

celaleyn:29-29.t: As Allah the Exalted said: ﴿مُحَمَّدٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿رَسُولُ اللَّهِ﴾ its khabar (predicate) ﴿وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ﴾ i.e. his Companions among the believers; a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is ﴿أَشِدَّاءُ﴾ harsh ﴿عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ﴾ they show them no mercy ﴿رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ a second khabar, i.e. sympathetic to and loving one another, like a father with his child ﴿تَرَاهُمْ﴾ you see them ﴿رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا﴾ two ḥāls (circumstantials) ﴿يَبْتَغُونَ﴾ resumptive (mustaʾnaf); they seek ﴿فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانًا سِيمَاهُمْ﴾ their marks; a mubtadaʾ ﴿فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾ its khabar; it is a light and whiteness by which they will be known in the Hereafter as having prostrated in this world ﴿مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ﴾ attached (mutaʿalliq) to that to which the khabar is attached, i.e. «كَائِنَةً» ("being"), and it is parsed as a ḥāl from its pronoun that has moved over to the khabar ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. the description mentioned ﴿مَثَلُهُمْ﴾ their description ﴿فِي التَّوْرَاةِ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar ﴿وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ﴾ a mubtadaʾ; its khabar is: ﴿كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ﴾ with sukūn and with fatḥa on the ṭāʾ; its offshoots ﴿فَآزَرَهُ﴾ with the long vowel and the short; strengthened and supported it ﴿فَاسْتَغْلَظَ﴾ became thick ﴿فَاسْتَوَى﴾ became strong and upright ﴿عَلَى سُوقِهِ﴾ its stalks; the plural of «سَاق» ﴿يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ﴾ i.e. its sowers, because of its beauty. The Companions, may Allah be pleased with them, were likened to this because they began few and weak, then grew many and strong in the best of ways ﴿لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ﴾ attached (mutaʿalliq) to something omitted indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «شُبِّهُوا بِذَلِكَ» ("they were likened to that") ﴿وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُمْ﴾ i.e. the Companions; «مِنْ» is for explaining the genus (bayān al-jins), not partitive, because all of them have the description mentioned ﴿مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا﴾ the Garden; and these two are also for those after them, in [other] ayahs.

daas-irab:1-5.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿فَتَحْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَتْحاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مُبِيناً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the lām. ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to fataḥnā. ﴿تَقَدَّمَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما تَأَخَّرَ﴾ conjoined to mā taqaddama. ﴿وَيُتِمَّ﴾ conjoined to yaghfira. ﴿نِعْمَتَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَيَهْدِيَكَ﴾ conjoined to yaghfira; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿صِراطاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُسْتَقِيماً﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَيَنْصُرَكَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿نَصْراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿عَزِيزاً﴾ an adjective. ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيَزْدادُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit an after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِيماناً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām of causation, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to anzala. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿إِيمانِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿جُنُودُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to al-samāwāt; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾ two khabars of kāna; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لِيُدْخِلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit an after the lām of causation, with its fāʿil latent; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām of causation, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, its implied form being "He commanded jihad in order to admit" (amara bi-l-jihād li-yudkhila). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾ conjoined to al-muʾminīn. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of jannāt. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to khālidīn. ﴿وَيُكَفِّرَ﴾ a conjunction, and conjoined to yudkhila. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سَيِّئاتِهِمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw of circumstance, and a defective past verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ its noun. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَوْزاً﴾ the khabar of kāna. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ an adjective; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:6-9.t: ﴿وَيُعَذِّبَ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْمُنافِقاتِ﴾ conjoined to al-munāfiqīn. ﴿وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكاتِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الظَّانِّينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) al-ẓānnīn. ﴿ظَنَّ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿السَّوْءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿دائِرَةُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّوْءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَلَعَنَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَساءَتْ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a past verb of blame (dhamm) whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَصِيراً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a fronted khabar. ﴿جُنُودُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to al-samāwāt; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزاً حَكِيماً﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and kāna, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿شاهِداً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَمُبَشِّراً وَنَذِيراً﴾ conjoined to shāhidan. ﴿لِتُؤْمِنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to arsalnāka. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to tuʾminū. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ﴾ conjoined to tuʾminū. ﴿بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا﴾ two adverbs of time (ẓarfā zamān).

daas-irab:10-11.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يُبايِعُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّما﴾ a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُبايِعُونَ اللَّهَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿يَدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a fatḥa (اللَّهَ); as muḍāf ilayhi it is اللَّهِ.] ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is a second khabar of inna. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿نَكَثَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, and innamā is a restraining particle and the restrained one. ﴿يَنْكُثُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿عَلى نَفْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a conjunction, and a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْفى﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿عاهَدَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb and its first object. ﴿أَجْراً﴾ its second object. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿سَيَقُولُ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْمُخَلَّفُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْأَعْرابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to al-mukhallafūn. ﴿شَغَلَتْنا أَمْوالُنا﴾ a past verb and its object, and amwālunā is its fāʿil. ﴿وَأَهْلُونا﴾ conjoined to amwālunā; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاسْتَغْفِرْ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of laysa; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), and an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَمْلِكُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, the nominal clause is the object of the saying, and the clause qul is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to yamliku. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to yamliku. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿أَرادَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿ضَرًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَرادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعاً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to khabīran. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿خَبِيراً﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause kāna is resumptive.

daas-irab:12-14.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī). ﴿ظَنَنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy anna; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), omitted. ﴿لَنْ يَنْقَلِبَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan. ﴿الرَّسُولُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ conjoined to al-rasūl; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of an. ﴿إِلى أَهْلِيهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَبَداً﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of ẓanantum, and the clause ẓanantum is resumptive. ﴿وَزُيِّنَ ذلِكَ﴾ a conjunction, and a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَظَنَنْتُمْ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ظَنَّ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿السَّوْءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ its khabar. ﴿بُوراً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَمْ يُؤْمِنْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, with its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَإِنَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of causation (taʿlīl), and inna and its noun. ﴿أَعْتَدْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سَعِيراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar of inna, the nominal clause is a causal explanation, and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿مُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to al-samāwāt. ﴿يَغْفِرُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent, the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause yaghfiru is resumptive. ﴿وَيُعَذِّبُ﴾ conjoined to yaghfiru, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and kāna, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ﴾ the sīn is a particle of the future, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذَا﴾ an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿انْطَلَقْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِلى مَغانِمَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿لِتَأْخُذُوها﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the wāw is its fāʿil and hā its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to inṭalaqtum. ﴿ذَرُونا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and nā its object. ﴿نَتَّبِعْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause dharūnā is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿كَلامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is the object of yurīdūna. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَنْ تَتَّبِعُونا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by lan; the wāw is its fāʿil and nā its object; the clause is the object of the saying, and the clause qul is resumptive. ﴿كَذلِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿قالَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَسَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, the sīn is a particle of the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) or conjunction. ﴿تَحْسُدُونَنا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and nā its object; the clause is conjoined to sa-yaqūlūna. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَفْقَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kānū, and the clause kānū is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِلْمُخَلَّفِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنَ الْأَعْرابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to al-mukhallafīn; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَتُدْعَوْنَ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلى قَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to tudʿawna. ﴿أُولِي﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of qawm, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿بَأْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَدِيدٍ﴾ an adjective of baʾs. ﴿تُقاتِلُونَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُسْلِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and in is a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿تُطِيعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يُؤْتِكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive in that it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿أَجْراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَسَناً﴾ an adjective; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and in is a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿تَتَوَلَّوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a particle of comparison and of the genitive, and mā is maṣdariyya (yielding a verbal noun). ﴿تَوَلَّيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to tawallaytum. ﴿يُعَذِّبْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿أَلِيماً﴾ an adjective; the clause is the apodosis of a jussive-causing condition, not joined to the fāʾ, and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:17-18.t: ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عَلَى الْأَعْمى﴾ the fronted khabar (predicate) of laysa. ﴿حَرَجٌ﴾ its postponed noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and man is a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُطِعِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined to the Name of Majesty. ﴿يُدْخِلْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of man, and the clause yudkhilhu is the apodosis with no grammatical position, because it is not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of jannāt, and the nominal clause man… is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذاباً أَلِيماً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿رَضِيَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the answer to the oath. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿يُبايِعُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تَحْتَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿الشَّجَرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَعَلِمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [element that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَأَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَأَثابَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its first object, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿فَتْحاً﴾ its second object. ﴿قَرِيباً﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:19-21.t: ﴿وَمَغانِمَ﴾ a conjunction, and conjoined to fatḥan. ﴿كَثِيرَةً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿يَأْخُذُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and hā its object; the clause is an adjective of maghānim. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزاً حَكِيماً﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna, its noun and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَعَدَكُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a postponed fāʿil. ﴿مَغانِمَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَثِيرَةً﴾ an adjective; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَأْخُذُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is an adjective of maghānim. ﴿فَعَجَّلَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكَفَّ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَيْدِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلِتَكُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), its noun being latent. ﴿آيَةً﴾ its khabar. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to kaffa. ﴿وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿صِراطاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُسْتَقِيماً﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأُخْرى﴾ a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is an adjective of ukhrā. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿أَحاطَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to qadīran. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيراً﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:22-24.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and law is a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿قاتَلَكُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَوَلَّوُا﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْأَدْبارَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَجِدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾ its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿نَصِيراً﴾ conjoined to waliyyan. ﴿سُنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّتِي﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of sunna. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَتْ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَلَنْ تَجِدَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿لِسُنَّةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to tabdīlan. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَبْدِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَّ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِبَطْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَكَّةَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to kaffa. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle causing the accusative. ﴿أَظْفَرَكُمْ﴾ a past verb in the position of the accusative; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to baṣīran. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause is the ṣila, and the clause kāna is resumptive.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿هُمُ الَّذِينَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَصَدُّوكُمْ﴾ conjoined to kafarū. ﴿عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of al-masjid. ﴿وَالْهَدْيَ﴾ mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), and the wāw is for accompaniment (maʿiyya). ﴿مَعْكُوفاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنْ يَبْلُغَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, with its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿مَحِلَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lawlā is a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿رِجالٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted. ﴿مُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَنِساءٌ مُؤْمِناتٌ﴾ conjoined to rijālun muʾminūn. ﴿لَمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ تَطَؤُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is a badal (substitute) of the hāʾ in taʿlamūhum. ﴿فَتُصِيبَكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it, and the kāf is its object. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مَعَرَّةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the object of tuṣībakum. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيُدْخِلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿فِي رَحْمَتِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar from an and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted and implied. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿تَزَيَّلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَذَّبْنَا﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of law and has no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source reads «جواب لولا محل لها», evidently «جواب لو لا محل لها» run together.] ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَلِيماً﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:26-27.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) jaʿala. ﴿الْحَمِيَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿حَمِيَّةَ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿الْجاهِلِيَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَأَنْزَلَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿سَكِينَتَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلى رَسُولِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its first object, with its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿كَلِمَةَ﴾ its second object. ﴿التَّقْوى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun. ﴿أَحَقَّ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to aḥaqqa. ﴿وَأَهْلَها﴾ conjoined to aḥaqqa. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna and its noun. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ʿalīman. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيماً﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām falls in the answer to an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿صَدَقَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿رَسُولَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الرُّؤْيا﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ṣadaqa; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَتَدْخُلُنَّ﴾ the lām of the answer to the omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the nūn that is dropped because of the succession of like letters; the dropped wāw is its fāʿil, and the nūn is for emphasis; the clause is the answer to an omitted oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْمَسْجِدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَرامَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿شاءَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil; the verbal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the context indicates it. ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مُحَلِّقِينَ﴾ a second ḥāl. ﴿رُؤُسَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمُقَصِّرِينَ﴾ conjoined to muḥalliqīn. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَخافُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿فَعَلِمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ its object; the clause is conjoined to ṣadaqa. ﴿لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَجَعَلَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَتْحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَرِيباً﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:28-29.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرْسَلَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿رَسُولَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِالْهُدى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَدِينِ﴾ conjoined to al-hudā. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيُظْهِرَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَى الدِّينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿كُلِّهِ﴾ a tawkīd (emphasis) of al-dīn; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to arsala. ﴿وَكَفى﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil of kafā. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿أَشِدَّاءُ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ashiddāʾ. ﴿رُحَماءُ﴾ a second khabar. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to ruḥamāʾ. ﴿تَراهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رُكَّعاً سُجَّداً﴾ two ḥāls. ﴿يَبْتَغُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَضْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to faḍlan. ﴿وَرِضْواناً﴾ conjoined to faḍlan. ﴿سِيماهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿مِنْ أَثَرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿السُّجُودِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿فِي التَّوْراةِ﴾ ḥāl; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَثَلُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿كَزَرْعٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of zarʿ. ﴿فَآزَرَهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined to akhraja. ﴿فَاسْتَغْلَظَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَاسْتَوى﴾ also conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلى سُوقِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to istawā. ﴿يُعْجِبُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الزُّرَّاعَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِيَغِيظَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the implicit an after the lām of causation, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِهِمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْكُفَّارِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (الْكُفَّارِ); as mafʿūl bihi it is الْكُفَّارَ.] The interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to waʿada. ﴿وَعَدَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, and the clause waʿada is resumptive. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ conjoined to āmanū. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مَغْفِرَةً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of waʿada. ﴿وَأَجْراً﴾ conjoined to maghfira. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ an adjective.

farraa:1-1.t:
His saying: ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحاً مُّبِيناً﴾.
It was a victory (fatḥ) in which there was [little] fighting: a throwing of stones at one another. A fatḥ may be a peace settlement, and it may be the taking of a thing by force; and the fighting [179/a] that was meant was only on the day of al-Ḥudaybiya.

farraa:6-6.t:
His saying: ﴿دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ﴾.
Like your saying: "a man of evil (رجل السَّوء)"; and دائرة السوء is the punishment. Al-sawʾ [with fatḥa] is more widespread and more frequent in the language, and the Arabs seldom say: دائرة السُّوء.

farraa:8-9.t:
His saying: ﴿إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِداً﴾, then He said: ﴿لِّتُؤْمِنُواْ﴾.
Its meaning is: that whoever believes may believe in you. And it has been said ليؤمنوا [with yāʾ], because the believer is other than the one addressed, so the meaning is: We have sent you so that they may believe in you. The meaning in the first is intended like this, even though it is like the one addressed, because you say to a group: "You have done [it]", while not all of them did it, i.e. some of you did; so this is evidence of that.
His saying: ﴿وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ﴾.
You support him with the sword; so it is reported from al-Kalbī.

farraa:10-10.t: His saying: ﴿يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: in fulfilment and covenant.

farraa:11-11.t:
His saying: ﴿سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلأَعْرَابِ﴾.
Those who stayed behind from al-Ḥudaybiya: "Our wealth and our families kept us busy." They were Bedouins: Aslam, Juhayna, Muzayna and Ghifār. They thought that the Messenger of Allah, Allah bless him, would never return, so they stayed behind.
His saying: ﴿إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرّاً﴾.
Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb alone gave the ḍād ḍamma, and ʿĀṣim, the people of Medina and al-Ḥasan gave it fatḥa: "ضَراً".

farraa:12-12.t:
His saying: ﴿أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَداً﴾; and in the reading of ʿAbd Allāh: "إلى أهلهم", without yāʾ; and al-ahl is plural and singular.
His saying: ﴿وَكُنتُمْ قَوْماً بُوراً﴾.
[Muḥammad narrated to us, saying:] al-Farrāʾ narrated to us, saying: Ḥibbān narrated to me, from al-Kalbī, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said: al-būr in the dialect of Azd ʿUmān is the corrupt; "and you were a people būr": a corrupt people. And al-būr in the speech of the Arabs is: nothing. One says: "Their deeds became būr (naught) and their dwellings graves."

farraa:15-15.t:
His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا﴾.
He means Khaybar, because Allah opened it to His Messenger straight after al-Ḥudaybiya. They said that to the Messenger of Allah: "Let us follow you." He said: "Yes, on condition that no share is given to you; if you go out on that basis, then go out." They said to the Muslims: "This is not yours; you have done this to us only out of envy." The Muslims said: "Thus Allah said to us before you said it."
His saying: ﴿يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُواْ كلِمَ ٱللَّهِ﴾.
Yaḥyā alone read it (كَلِم), and the readers after him (كلام الله), with alif. Al-kalām is a maṣdar (verbal noun), and al-kalim is the plural of kalima. The meaning in His saying "يريدُونَ أن يبدلوا كلم الله" is: they hoped he would permit them, and so change the word of Allah. Then it was said: if you desire only raiding and jihād and not the spoils, you will be called tomorrow against the people of al-Yamāma, against a people of great might, the Banū Ḥanīfa, the followers of Musaylima. This is from the exegesis of al-Kalbī.

farraa:16-16.t:
His saying: ﴿تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ﴾.
In one of the two readings: أو يُسْلِموا. And the meaning is: you will fight them forever until they submit; that is, unless they submit, you will fight them, or there will be [179/b] Islam from them.

farraa:17-17.t: His saying: ﴿لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ﴾: in abandoning the raid, to the end of the verse.

farraa:18-18.t:
His saying: ﴿تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ﴾: it was an acacia (samura).
His saying: ﴿فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾.
The Prophet, Allah bless him, had been shown in his sleep that he would enter Mecca. When that was not made possible for him, and he made peace with the people of Mecca on the condition that they would vacate it for him for three days in the following year, a great matter came upon the Muslims. The Prophet, Allah bless him, said to them: "It was only a dream that I was shown, and it was not revelation from heaven." So He knew what was in their hearts, and sent down tranquillity (al-sakīna) upon them. Al-sakīna is reassurance and composure in what the Prophet, Allah bless him, told them: that it was for the following year. That is His saying: ﴿فَعَلِمَ ما لَمْ تَعْلَموا﴾: of the good of the dream's fulfilment.

farraa:20-20.t:
His saying: ﴿وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا﴾: of what will be after today; and He hastened this for you: Khaybar.
His saying: ﴿وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْكُمْ﴾.
Asad and Ghaṭafān were with the people of Khaybar against the Messenger of Allah, Allah bless him. The Prophet, Allah bless him, made for them, and they made peace with him, held back, and left him to deal with the people of Khaybar. That is His saying: ﴿وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْكُمْ﴾.

farraa:21-21.t:
His saying: ﴿وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُواْ عَلَيْهَا﴾.
Persia: Allah has encompassed it, encompassed it for you, to open it to you.

farraa:24-25.t:
His saying: ﴿وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم﴾.
This is for the people of al-Ḥudaybiya, not for the people of Khaybar.
His saying: ﴿وَٱلْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفاً﴾: detained.
His saying: ﴿أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ﴾: its place of slaughter, i.e. they barred the sacrificial animals.
His saying: ﴿وَلَوْلاَ رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌ مُّؤْمِنَاتٌ﴾.
There were Muslims in Mecca, so He said: were it not that you would kill them without knowing them, and a liability (maʿarra) would fall on you because of them, meaning the blood-money. Then Allah, Majestic and Mighty, said: ﴿لَوْ تَزَيَّلُواْ﴾: had the unbelievers been separated and set apart from the believers, Allah would have sent down killing and punishment upon them.

farraa:26-26.t:
His saying: ﴿إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ﴾.
They were roused by pride, [refusing] that the Messenger of Allah, Allah bless him, should enter it upon them. So Allah sent down His tranquillity; he says: Allah removed from the believers [the danger] that the zealotry that entered those people should enter them, so that they would disobey Allah and His Messenger.
His saying: ﴿كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ﴾: "There is no god but Allah."
His saying: ﴿وَكَانُوۤاْ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا﴾.
I saw it in the codex of al-Ḥārith ibn Suwayd al-Taymī, one of the companions of ʿAbd Allāh: "وكانوا أهلها وأحق بها", and that is a fronting and postponing (taqdīm wa-taʾkhīr). His codex was buried in the days of al-Ḥajjāj.

farraa:27-27.t:
His saying: ﴿لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ [180/a] ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ آمِنِينَ﴾.
In the reading of ʿAbd Allāh: لا تخافون in place of آمنين; "مُحلِّقين رءوسكم ومُقَصِّرِينَ": had it been said محلقون ومقصرون, i.e. some of you shaving and some of you shortening, it would have been correct, [as] the poet said:
* وغودر البقل ملوى ومحصود *
(And the herbage was left, [some] withered and [some] harvested.)

farraa:28-28.t:
His saying: ﴿لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِ﴾.
It is said: the world will not pass away until Islam prevails over the people of every religion, or they pay the jizya to them. That is His saying: ﴿لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّه﴾.

farraa:29-29.t:
His saying: ﴿تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعاً سُجَّداً﴾: in the prayer.
His saying: ﴿سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾: it is the pallor from staying awake at night.
His saying: ﴿ذَلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي ٱلتَّوْرَاةِ﴾.
And in the Gospel also, like their likeness in the Qurʾān. And it is said: that is their likeness in the Torah, and their likeness in the Gospel is as a sown crop that puts forth its shoot (shaṭʾ); its shaṭʾ is the ears: the grain sprouts ten, eight and seven, and some of it strengthens the rest. That is His saying: (فآزره): it helped it and strengthened it; so [it] grew thick and stood upright; had it been one, it would not stand on a stalk. It is a parable Allah, Mighty and Majestic, struck for the Prophet, Allah bless him, when he went forth alone and then He strengthened him with his Companions, as He strengthened the grain with what sprouted from it.
Āzartu, uʾāziruhu, muʾāzaratan: I strengthened him and helped him; and that is al-muʾāzara.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليغفر» is genitive (majrūr) and attached to (mutaʿalliq) {فَتَحْنَا}; the preposition «من ذنبك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تقدَّم»; «صراطا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «إيمانا» is a tamyīz (specification); «مع» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «إيمانا». The clause «ولله جنود» is resumptive, as is the clause «وكان الله عليما»; «حكيما» is a second khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليدخل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «يبتليكم»; «جنات» is the second object. The clause «وكان ذلك» ... is parenthetical, and the adverb «عند» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «فوزا».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «ويعذب» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {وَيُكَفِّرَ}; «الظانين» is a naʿt (adjective); «ظن» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) governed by «الظانين». The clause «عليهم دائرة» is resumptive, and the clause «وغضب الله» is conjoined to the clause «عليهم دائرة». The clause «وساءت مصيرا» is resumptive; the fāʿil (agent) of «ساءت» is latent (mustatir), referring to «جهنم»; «مصيرا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "Hell".

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «ولله جنود» is resumptive, as is the clause «وكان الله عزيزا».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتؤمنوا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {أَرْسَلْنَاكَ}; «بكرة» is an adverb of time attached to «تسبِّحوه».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «إنما يبايعون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ», and the clause «يد الله فوق أيديهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يبايعونك». The clause «فمن نكث» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause «إن الذين ... », and «مَنْ» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «ومن أوفى» is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause; the second «مَنْ» is conditional, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «أوفى» is its khabar. In the pronominal hāʾ of «عليه», after the yāʾ, both ḍamma and kasra are permissible; they are two dialects. One says both وفَّى and أَوْفى. «أجرًا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The preposition «من الأعراب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المخلفون»; the clause «فاستغفر» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «شغلتنا»; the clause «يقولون» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «في قلوبهم» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «ليس». The maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) is implied, i.e. "if Allah intends something for you", and the fāʾ in «فمن» occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of the implied condition. The two prepositions «لكم» and «من الله» are attached to «يملك». The clause «إن أراد بكم ضرا» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; the preposition «بكم» is attached to a ḥāl from «ضرا». The clause «كان» is resumptive, and the preposition «بما» is attached to «خبيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «ظننتم» is resumptive. «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أَنْ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «ظن». «أبدًا» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينقلب». The clause «زُيِّن» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «ظننتم»; «ظنَّ» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «بورا» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «ومن لم يؤمن» is resumptive, and «مَنْ» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «للكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعتدنا», and the overt noun stands in place of the referring pronoun, i.e. "We have prepared for them".

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «ولله ملك» is resumptive; the clause «يغفر» is resumptive; and the clause «وكان» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The conditional clause is parenthetical; the clause «ذرونا» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying); the clause «نتبعكم» is the apodosis (jawāb) of the implied condition; the clause «يريدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المخلفون», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of «يريدون». The kāf in «كذلكم» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "Allah said a saying like that". «قبل» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قال»; the clause «قال» is resumptive. The clause «فسيقولون» is resumptive, and the maqūl al-qawl is implied, i.e. "this is not from Allah"; the clause «تحسدوننا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The clause «كانوا» is resumptive, and «قليلا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The preposition «من الأعراب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المخلفين»; «أولي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم»; the clause «تقاتلونهم» is a naʿt of «قوم»; and the conditional clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «سَتُدْعَوْن». «أجرا» is the second object. The kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a turning away like your turning away"; «ما» is maṣdariyya and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «عذابا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «ليس على الأعمى حرج» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the conditional clause is resumptive; «جنات» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «لقد رضي» is the response to the oath; «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رضي». The clause «فعلم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «يبايعونك», and the clause «فأنزل» is conjoined to the clause «علم». «فتحا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «ومغانم» is a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «فتحا»; the clause «يأخذونها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مغانم»; and the clause «وكان الله عزيزًا حكيما» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «وعدكم» is resumptive; «مغانم» is the second object, and the clause «تأخذونها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مغانم». The clause «فعجَّل» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «وعدكم». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ولتكون» is genitive and attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e. "and so that it may be a sign, He did that", and the implied clause «فعل» is conjoined to the clause «كفّ». «صراطا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: His words «وأخرى»: a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to {هَذِهِ}; the clause «لم تقدروا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أخرى»; the clause «قد أحاط الله بها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «عليها»; and the clause «وكان الله ... » is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «ثم لا يجدون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «سُنَّةَ» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "He ordained a practice", and the clause «ولن تجد» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «سَنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is resumptive. The two prepositions «عنكم» and «عنهم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كفَّ»; the preposition «ببطن» is attached to «كفَّ», as is «من بعد». «أن» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition «بما» is attached to «بصيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «هم الذين» is resumptive. «الهدي» is a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the kāf in «صدُّوكم»; «معكوفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الهدي»; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبلغ» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from «الهدي», i.e. "they barred the offering from reaching its place". The clause «ولولا رجال» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «هم الذين», and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "He would have permitted you the conquest and given you power over the idolaters". The interpreted maṣdar «أن تَطَئوهم» is a badal from «رجال» and «نساء»; the preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تصيبكم»; the preposition «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl from the kāf in «تصيبكم». The interpreted maṣdar «ليدخل» is genitive and attached to an omitted verb, i.e. "He did not permit the conquest so that He might admit". The conditional clause («لو» and what follows it) is resumptive, and the preposition «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «كفروا».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عذَّبنا». «جعل» here means "cast", transitive to one object, and the preposition «في قلوبهم» is attached to «جعل»; «حمية» is a badal (substitute). «كلمة» is the second object. The clause «وكانوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «ألزمهم»; «وأهلها» is a noun conjoined to «أحقَّ». The clause «وكان الله ... » is resumptive, and the preposition «بكل» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «عليما».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «لقد صدق» is the response to the first, implied oath, and the clause of the oath and its response is resumptive. «الرؤيا» is the second object; the preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الرؤيا». The clause «والله لتدخلُنَّ» explains the vision; the clause «لتدخلُن» is the response to the oath; the verb is an imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ) by the presence of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters, and the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent). The clause «إن شاء الله» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «محلِّقين» is a second ḥāl, and «رءوسكم» is the object of «مُحَلِّقين». The clause «لا تخافون» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «مقصِّرين». The clause «فعلم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «صدق الله», and the preposition «من دون» is attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The preposition «بالهدى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «رسوله»; the genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليظهره» is attached to «أرسل». The clause «وكفى بالله» is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent), the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and «شهيدا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «والذين معه أشداء» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause «محمد رسول الله». «معه»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); the preposition «على الكفار» is attached to «أشداء»; «رحماء» is a second khabar (predicate) of «الذين»; the adverb «بينهم» is attached to «رحماء»; the clause «تراهم» is a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject); «سُجَّدا» is a second ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «تراهم»; the clause «يبتغون» is a fourth khabar; the preposition «من الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «فضلا»; the clause «سيماهم في وجوههم» is a fifth khabar; the preposition «من أثر» is attached to the notion of being (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. The clause «ذلك مثلهم» is resumptive, made up of mubtadaʾ and khabar; the preposition «في التوراة» is attached to a ḥāl from «مثلهم». The clause «ومثلهم كزرع» is conjoined to the clause «ذلك مثلهم»; the preposition «في الإنجيل» is attached to a ḥāl from «مثلهم»; the preposition «كزرع» is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause «أخرج» is a naʿt of «زرع»; and the clause «يعجب» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «استوى». The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليغيظ» is attached to an implied verb, i.e. "they were likened". The clause «وعد الله» is resumptive; the preposition «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl from the wāw of «عملوا»; «مغفرة» is the second object.

mekki-muskil:2-2.t: His saying, Exalted is He, {ويهديك صراطا مُسْتَقِيمًا}: that is, "to a path" (إلى صراط); then إلى was omitted, so الصِّرَاط became accusative because it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) in meaning.

mekki-muskil:8-8.t: His saying {شَاهدا وَمُبشرا وَنَذِيرا}: the three are accusative as an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara, circumstantial), and they are circumstantial states of the كاف in أَرْسَلْنَاك; the governing word in them is أرسل, just as it is the governing word in the one the ḥāl describes (ṣāḥib al-ḥāl).

mekki-muskil:10-10.t: His saying {إِن الَّذين يُبَايعُونَك}: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ is إنما يبايعون الله. It is also possible that the khabar is يَد الله فَوق أَيْديهم, which is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar in the position of the khabar of إنّ.

mekki-muskil:16-16.t: His saying {تقاتلونهم أَو يسلمُونَ}: according to al-Kisāʾī, يسلمُونَ is conjoined to تقاتلون. Al-Zajjāj said it is resumptive, i.e. "or they will submit" (أو هم يسلمون). In the reading of Ubayy it is أَو يسلمُوا, in the accusative by an implied أنْ; its meaning according to the Basrans is "unless they submit" (إلا أن يسلموا), and al-Kisāʾī said its meaning is "until they submit" (حتى يسلموا).

mekki-muskil:21-21.t: His saying {وَأُخْرَى لم تقدروا}: أُخْرَى is in the position of the accusative by conjunction with مَغَانِم, and in the speech there is an omitted muḍāf; the implied form is "Allah promised you the possession of spoils and the possession of others" (وعدكم الله ملك مغانم وملك أخرى), because the second object of وعد can only be a maṣdar (verbal noun), since a promise does not fall on bodily things; it falls only on their possession and acquisition. You say وعدتك غلاما ("I promised you a slave-boy"): you did not promise him the person of the slave-boy, you only promised him possession of the person of a slave-boy.

mekki-muskil:23-23.t: His saying {سنة الله}: accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), because the meaning of {لولوا الأدبار} is "Allah has ordained their turning their backs as a practice (sunna), just as He ordained it for the disbelieving nations that passed away". In ordinary speech سنةٌ in the nominative is permissible, in the sense of "that is the practice", so you imply the mubtadaʾ (subject) and سنة is its khabar (predicate).

mekki-muskil:24-24.t: His saying {بِبَطن مَكَّة}: مَكَّة is a diptote because it is definite, a name for something feminine, namely the city.

mekki-muskil:25-25.t:
His saying {وَالْهَدْي معكوفا أَن يبلغ مَحَله}: الْهَدْي is accusative by conjunction with the كاف and the ميم in صدوكم, and أن is in the position of the accusative on the assumption of the omission of the preposition (accusative by removal of the preposition), i.e. "from reaching" (عن أن يبلغ).
His saying {وَلَوْلَا رجال مُؤمنُونَ وَنسَاء مؤمنات}: رجال is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), نسَاء is conjoined to them, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "present" (بالحضرة), or "in the place" (بالموضع), or "in Mecca" (بمكة), and the like.
His saying {أَن تطؤوهم}: أن is in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute) of رجال or نسَاء, or in the position of the accusative as a badal of the هاء and the ميم in تعلموهم. The implied form on the first view is "were it not for your trampling believing men whom you did not know, so that guilt would befall you on account of them"; on the second view, "were it not for believing men whose trampling you did not know, so that it would befall you". In both cases it is a badal of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl). The first view is clearer and stronger in meaning. Trampling (الوطء) here means killing.
And His saying {تعلموهم} is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of رجال and نسَاء, and the apodosis (jawāb) of لولا is omitted.

mekki-muskil:27-27.t: His saying {مُحَلِّقِينَ رؤوسكم وَمُقَصِّرِينَ}: two ḥāls (circumstantial) of the nominative latent pronoun in لتدخلن. The wāw is omitted from لتدخلن — it is the wāw of the plural pronoun — and it was omitted because it is quiescent and the first letter of the doubled consonant is quiescent. Likewise لا تخافون is also a ḥāl of them, i.e. "not fearing".

mekki-muskil:29-29.t:
His saying {مُحَمَّد رَسُول الله}: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). {وَالَّذين مَعَه أشداء} is also a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and رحماء is a second khabar. So the statement of severity and mercy, and what follows it of their bowing and prostrating and the coining of parables about them, is about those who are with the Prophet; and the Prophet ﷺ is of a higher rank than them, because they attained this rank only through him and at his hands ﷺ.
It is also said: مُحَمَّد is a mubtadaʾ, رسول الله is a naʿt (adjective) of it, والذين معه is conjoined to مُحَمَّد, أشداء is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ about them all, and رحماء is a second khabar about them. So the Prophet, upon him be blessing and peace, is included in everything that is stated about them: severity, mercy, bowing, prostration and the parables mentioned. On the first view you pause on رسول الله ﷺ, and you do not pause on it on the second view.
His saying {ركعا سجدا}: two ḥāls (circumstantial) of the هاء and the ميم in {تراهم}, because it is from seeing with the eye; likewise {يَبْغُونَ} is also a ḥāl of them.
His saying {سِيمَاهُمْ}: a mubtadaʾ; {من أثر السُّجُود} is the khabar. It is also possible that the khabar is {فِي وُجُوههم}, and that is clearer and better.
His saying {ذَلِك مثلهم فِي التَّوْرَاة}: ذلك is a mubtadaʾ and مثلهم is the khabar.
His saying {وَمثلهمْ فِي الْإِنْجِيل}: conjoined to the first مثل; so you do not pause on التوراة if you make it [conjoined] to the first مثل. The meaning is then that they have been described in the Torah and the Gospel with these preceding attributes, and the كاف in His saying كزرع أخرج شطأه is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they are like a sown field" (هم كزرع); so you begin with the كاف and pause on الإنجيل.
It is also possible that {وَمثلهمْ فِي الْإِنْجِيل} is a mubtadaʾ and كزرع the khabar; then you pause on التوراة and begin with ومثلهم في الإنجيل كزرع, and you do not pause on الإنجيل nor begin with the كاف on this view, because it is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The meaning is then that they have been described in the two Books with two descriptions: they were described in the Torah as being severe against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves, you see them bowing and prostrating, seeking bounty from Allah and good pleasure, and that their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration; and they were described in the Gospel as being like a sown field that puts forth its shoot, to the end of the description. The first view is the view of Mujāhid, and the second is the view of al-Ḍaḥḥāk and Qatāda.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿إنا فتحنا لك﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾: its noun; the clause فتحنا is its khabar (predicate); لك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فتحنا﴾.
﴿فتحًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿مبينًا﴾: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿إن الذين يبايعونك إنما يبايعون الله﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين: its noun; the clause ﴿يبايعونك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. إنما: [إنّ] made inoperative (makfūfa) by the preventing [mā] (kāffa); the clause إنما يبايعون الله is the khabar (predicate) of إن; what is meant by this pledge is the Pledge of Riḍwān at al-Ḥudaybiya.
﴿يد الله فوق أيديهم﴾: يد الله: mubtadaʾ (subject); فوق أيديهم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of يد الله; the clause is a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) pronoun in يبايعونك, or also resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن نكث فإنما ينكث﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; من: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; نكث: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; إنما: [إنّ] made inoperative by the preventing [mā]; ينكث: an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the clause ﴿فمن نكث...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿على نفسه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينكث﴾; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
